findings.summary: data/eslesmeyen_kasa_ifadeleri.json race condition via raw save_json_safe instead of persistence_manager.queue_write
route_context lost AI's r.get('type','') hint, risking a matching-quality regression vs prior behavior
Restoring 'type' into route_context made bare tonnage codes (e.g. '1360') match a generic rule, making type_match truthy and completely skipping kasa_tipi_belirsiz flag logic for nearly all routes
findings.fix: has_hint computed from a separate hint_context that excludes the AI's 'type' field; uncertainty gated on is_generic_kasa (output value equals {AÇIK,KAPALI})

findings.summary: is_generic_kasa (comparing matched output value to hardcoded {AÇIK,KAPALI}) false-flags legitimate rules whose correct, intentional output is exactly AÇIK+KAPALI (e.g. explicit customer statement 'kapalı açık farketmez'), violating AC-1's no-regression guarantee
findings.fix: Removed is_generic_kasa entirely. Uncertainty now gated purely on has_hint (real message text) crossed with type_match truthiness: has_hint=False -> ipucu_yok; has_hint=True and no type_match -> kural_eslesmedi; has_hint=True and type_match exists -> confident match, no flag (verified matcher correctly reflects real hints like FRİGO into specific output rather than discarding them into the generic default)
findings.verified: direct Python reproduction ('kapalı açık farketmez' -> no flag) + independent pytest (18/18) + syntax check

findings.summary: data/eslesmeyen_kasa_ifadeleri.json write path (load_json_safe -> append -> persistence_manager.queue_write) is not atomic; queue_write only enqueues a full-list snapshot without re-reading at flush time, so concurrent routes/messages processed via asyncio.gather can race and silently drop log entries
findings.reason: Fixing properly requires changing persistence_manager.py's shared queue_write contract (used by other call sites) to support an atomic worker-side read+append primitive — out of proportion to this task's CAVEMAN scope. Affected data is best-effort diagnostic/log data for future rule-table tuning, not business-critical output; does not affect the shipment data sent to YukBurada.
